claim_contract.scope: Static observer-pose changes around two fixed world marker layouts, one intrinsic calibration and two backgrounds.
claim_contract.camera_pose_convention: C=W0 A, B=W0 O, A=[Rz(roll) Ry(yaw) Rx(pitch),t]; camera point R^T(q0-t)

qualification.scope: Finite independent 2D code/phase/size/background/mixing grid; not natural object identity or a real-camera bound.

execution_validation.scope: Input, readback and arithmetic validation; world-coordinate constancy is in the simulator frame, not external metrology.

artifact_integrity_scope: Rows and equivalences store all96 PNG hashes; saved per-case records and observations were independently read back. This manifest hashes expectations, input records, summaries and analysis files.

camera_translation_can_be_ignored_in_all.reason: ignore_camera_translation fits 20/44 primary pairs; all 44 have valid readouts.

camera_rotation_can_be_ignored_in_all_co.reason: ignore_camera_rotation fits 20/44 primary pairs; all 44 have valid readouts.

forward_pose_can_replace_inverse_pose_in.reason: forward_instead_of_inverse fits 4/44 primary pairs; all 44 have valid readouts.

camera_attached_target_explains_fixed_wo.reason: target_attached_to_camera fits 4/44 primary pairs; all 44 have valid readouts.

coded_marker_positions_uniquely_identify.reason: Four isolated path pairs use different recorded camera/object world states but produce the same position readouts.

continuous_motion_and_temporal_alignment.reason: The conditions are independent static snapshots; no complete timed trajectory or moving occlusion was tested.

real_AD_fitness_or_direct_real_sim_equiv.reason: No AD, independently calibrated real pair, natural vehicle shape, actuator dynamics or task margin was tested.

instrument.component: RGB coded identity and centroid instrument
instrument.expected: The predeclared finite 2D grid meets unchanged 0.25 px position and 0.5 px width gates; three invalid controls block.
instrument.observed: 768/768 identities correct, maximum coordinate error 0.090974212034439 px, all invalid controls blocked.
instrument.implication: Finite literal artificial-marker qualification only, not arbitrary patterns or real-camera uncertainty.

fixed_world_camera_pose.component: Actual HUGSIM camera extrinsics with fixed object world pose
fixed_world_camera_pose.expected: Changing the camera applies inverse extrinsics to fixed world points and matches all qualified marker observations.
fixed_world_camera_pose.observed: 44/44 pairs fit, maximum residual 0.06799276290632861 px. Each fixture retains one body-pose tensor hash while using eleven camera poses; no readouts unqualified.
fixed_world_camera_pose.implication: Finite simulator-frame camera/geometry consistency; world-frame external calibration and continuous motion remain unqualified.

isolated_equivalence.expected: The same relative pose produces matching coded positions in the isolated constant-appearance setup; each path also matches the independent absolute projection.
isolated_equivalence.observed: 4/4 route comparisons fit 0.5 px; observed coordinate difference is 0 px; all four object routes fit 0.25 px absolute predictions with maximum 0.0478832056684837 px.
isolated_equivalence.implication: Quantized finite readout agreement, not zero physical error or an independent real-world evidence source.

candidate_ignore_camera_translation.observed: ignore_camera_translation fits 20/44 primary pairs; all 44 have valid readouts.
candidate_ignore_camera_translation.implication: Candidate prediction contradicted; this is not a count of HUGSIM defects or a universal failure claim.

observational_ambiguity.component: Identifiability of world intervention from coded target position readouts
observational_ambiguity.expected: Position readouts alone would uniquely distinguish which world intervention produced them.
observational_ambiguity.observed: All four isolated camera-change/inverse-object-change pairs have identical position readouts although the recorded world states differ.
observational_ambiguity.implication: Retain simulator world states and intervention logs; this finite ambiguity does not establish any general causal representation result.

limitations: Static camera-pose snapshots, not continuous motion, timing or ego dynamics.
Only two coded marker fixtures, one intrinsic calibration and two contexts; no ordinary vehicle or real-AD validation.
Equivalence applies only in isolated background; affine appearance and scene visibility can depend on viewpoint.
No direct real-sim, world-frame external calibration, complete alphabet, or driving-task claim.
